entities.summary: Daniel Evans is a British professional tennis player. He has been ranked as high as world No. 21 in singles by the ATP, which he achieved on 7 August 2023. He reached a career-high ranking of No. 52 in doubles on 26 April 2021. In 2015, he was part of the winning British Davis Cup team.
